injuries.name: Brandon Miller
injuries.detail: Miller (groin) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Phoenix.

injuries.name: Moussa Diabate
injuries.detail: Diabate (quadriceps) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.detail: Schroder has been diagnosed with a left hamstring strain and will be reevaluated in two weeks, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Thursday's game in Minnesota.

injuries.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
injuries.detail: Johnson (shin) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Thursday's game at Minnesota.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is out for Thursday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren (hamstring) has begun on-court activity and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Hunter Patterson of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Monday against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Ugonna Onyenso
injuries.detail: Onyenso agreed to a two-way contract with the Pistons on Thursday.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: LeBron James
injuries.detail: James (back) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Raptors, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid (foot) is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against Toronto, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Head coach Nick Nurse said Wednesday that Barlow (back) likely needs another 10-12 days before he's cleared to return to the court, Derek Bodner of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Adem Bona
injuries.detail: Bona (back) is out for Thursday's game against the Raptors, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Scottie Barnes
injuries.detail: Barnes (groin) is out for Wednesday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Head coach Darko Rajakovic said Wednesday that Leonard (knee) is doing individual on-court work and is progressing well, Michael Grange of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Trayce Jackson-Davis
injuries.detail: Jackson-Davis (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Celtics, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Detroit.
